t: In front of you is the statue of Oliver Cromwell, outside the House of Commons. It is the work of the sculptor Hamo Thornycroft, who was one of the youngest artists ever elected to the Royal Academy. Cromwell was a Parliamentarian commander in the Wars of the Three Kingdoms and a leading advocate of the execution of Charles the First in January 1649. He ruled as Lord Protector from December 1653 until his death in September 1658. Directly opposite, in the wall of St Margaret's Church across the road, is a bust of Charles the First.
